tasks.natural_request: In scripts/code_lm_run_lock.py, make release_run_lock unlink a lock only when the supplied path still names the same filesystem object as the acquired file descriptor. It must always close the descriptor, preserve a replacement lock created after acquisition, and never unlink a different supplied lock path, while preserving normal acquire-and-release behavior. Add focused run-lock tests.

In scripts/hive_node_registry.py, make timestamp_age_seconds fail closed with None rather than raising for timezone-naive timestamps, and reject timestamps more than five seconds in the future. Preserve correct elapsed-age calculation for timezone-aware ISO-8601 timestamps with Z or explicit UTC offsets, allowing at most five seconds of clock skew to clamp to zero. Add focused registry tests.

In scripts/training_data_admission_v1.py, make generated-data license admission use the same canonical normalization as normalize_license so project_generated and private_generated are admitted in either underscore or hyphen form. Preserve all existing allowed SPDX identifiers and continue to block near-miss or extended generated-license names. Add focused training-data admission tests.
